provenance.asset_description: Juneteenth Flag, credit Nafsadh, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons : Flag divided evenly in half, with a blue top and red bottom and a gently arched line of division. In the middle is a solid white five pointed star surrounded by a blue/red area, then the white outline of a twelve-pointed star.
